lesson: Connected icon and letter colors do not define the same object. Use a clean source arrow silhouette and explicit foreground order with one continuous translated phrase. ASR can include clause silence in word timestamps; inspect actual native-audio energy and use short semantic caption units, preserving music speed.
limitations: Same Agent self-review; no independent reviewer or user acceptance claimed.
Local inpainting approximates hidden background; source arrow entry opacity is approximated.
Existing UVR soundtrack separation limitations remain; audio is unchanged rather than newly proved lossless.
The script remains source-specific; this is not proof of unattended generalization.
